app.title: Solin Remote
app.javascriptRequiredDetail: Enable JavaScript to use Solin remote control.
login.intro: Sign in to control this Solin projection on the local network.
login.offline: Solin is unreachable. Check the network and try again.
login.localProtection: Protected connection limited to your local network
login.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
login.sessionExpired: Your session expired. Sign in again.
setup.title: Set up Solin Remote
setup.intro: Trust this Solin once, then install the web app for quick, secure access on your local network.
setup.unavailable: Setup information is unavailable. Keep Solin open and check this device's network.
setup.trustDetail: The certificate protects your password and remote commands. Compare the short code below with the one shown in Solin before installing it.
setup.androidTrustSettings: Open Settings and search for “CA certificate”.
setup.androidTrustInstall: Choose Install a certificate › CA certificate, select solin-remote-root.cer from your downloads, and confirm with your device lock.
setup.androidTrustConfirm: Approve Android's security notice only after the verification code matches Solin.
setup.androidTrustVariation: Menu names can vary by manufacturer. Opening the downloaded file directly may only redirect you to Settings.
setup.appleTrustDownload: Download the certificate in Safari, open Settings, and tap Profile Downloaded. If it is not shown, open General › VPN & Device Management.
setup.appleTrustInstall: Tap Install and follow the confirmation prompts.
setup.appleTrustEnable: Open General › About › Certificate Trust Settings and enable full trust for Solin Remote Root.
setup.genericTrust: Install the downloaded file as a trusted certificate authority for this device.
setup.reopenDetail: Fully close and reopen the browser. The privacy warning should no longer appear.
setup.androidRestart: If Chrome still shows the warning after the CA certificate is installed, restart Android once and reopen the address.
setup.appleReopen: On iPhone or iPad, return to Safari after enabling full trust and reopen the address.
setup.installDetail: Install Solin Remote to open it without the browser address bar.
setup.installManualAndroid: In Chrome, open the ⋮ menu, choose Add to Home screen, then choose Install rather than Add shortcut.
setup.installManualApple: In Safari, tap Share › Add to Home Screen, enable Open as Web App, then tap Add.
setup.installManual: Use your browser menu and choose Install app or Add to Home Screen.

library.emptyDetail: Changes made in Solin will appear here automatically.
